workload.note: Down year in Baltimore before free agency.

contract.note: 3-year, $40M contract with NYG as an unrestricted free agent from Baltimore. NYG team-facts source says signed 2026-03-09; Wikipedia's Likely page says 2026-03-12 - minor date conflict, both cited, team-adjacent source (NYG season page) treated as more likely accurate but not confirmed.

scheme.note: NYG hired John Harbaugh as HC on 2026-01-17 (Harbaugh was Likely's former HC in Baltimore for 2022-2025) and Matt Nagy as OC on 2026-02-03 (from Kansas City). Likely reuniting with Harbaugh is a notable subplot in his signing.

notes: Ourlads NYG TE depth chart: Isaiah Likely (1, starter), Theo Johnson (2), Chris Manhertz (3), Thomas Fidone II (4), Tanner Conner (5).
Giants also fired HC Brian Daboll on 2025-11-10 after a 2-8 start; Mike Kafka was interim before Harbaugh's hire.

injury.note: No injury reported for Likely as of 2026-08-11. An SI/Onsi Giants article titled 'Isaiah Likely Is the Giants' Breakout Fantasy Football Sleeper at Tight End' (dated 2026-07-19) exists but full text could not be retrieved - headline only.
